note.title: Democracy Now! report
note.text: Democracy Now! reported that the Gulf Labor Coalition staged an hour-long occupation of the Israeli Pavilion's second floor at the 2015 Biennale. The group also protests migrant labour used to build the Guggenheim Abu Dhabi.

note.title: Democracy Now! report
note.text: Democracy Now!, citing the Wall Street Journal, reported a White House plan for a far-reaching review of Smithsonian exhibitions to align them with Trump's interpretation of U.S. history. It followed the removal of references to his impeachments.

note.title: Rouanet Law and tax incentives
note.text: One Rouanet use found: the Cahiers d'Art Institute page says the Tunga catalogue raisonné is sponsored by Itaú and Sabesp through the Rouanet Law. No amounts or budget share published.
